main_text.p: ἑκατομβαιῶνος, quæ fere in 1 uel cidit, quo Syrius mane exoriebatur annos 2 3 2 3, Est enim annus Christi annus olympiadis 5 8 1.

Post initium Olympiadum usq; ad claruerunt, Leostratus Tenedius autem, quod duas olympiades seu octo annos nebat. Hanc Leostratus in eum finem ut cum Græci Lunaribus annis uti fere diebus à solaribus deficiebant, intercalatis, quos ἐμβολίμους vocabant, quod deerat, & lunares in solares solis cursum accommodaret.

Methon Atheniensis filius Pausaniæ, qui ἀνεκαθιστὰ κατηγοιδα instituit circa 8 7 olympiadem. Cum enim ὀκτοετηρίς non præstaret, quod debebat, ipse accuratius consideratis motibus deprehendit 19 annis solaribus, 235 menses compleri. Ad annos igitur lunares 19 mensibus 7 adiectis, præter illum diem, quem ad finem cuiusq; olympiadis Græ 2 Iulij diem in‥ cum sole, Ante ci 1550, quar‥

page.notes: Marginal figures "333" at right edge are cut off. The Greek words in the first line and the Methon paragraph are transcribed as far as legible; their exact accents are doubtful. Right part of the page is not visible. The text is cut off on the left side of the scan; line beginnings are missing. Greek word "ὀκτοέτηρίς" is a doubtful reading. Lines are rendered approximately, with partial words as they appear at the right edge. Bottom line "ci ad" is probably a catchword or signature in italic. The line "2 Iulij diem" shows a numeral 1550 printed in old form.
